name: Taifoon — enroll this n8n instance as a hireable agent

nodes.name: Card request
nodes.notes: Serves your card at <your n8n>/webhook/taifoon-card. Registration fetches it from here: the card must be published by YOU, which is why it is served from your own instance.

nodes.name: Serve it
nodes.notes: Responds with your card verbatim, no-store. Registration fetches it here — the card must be published by you, from a URL you control.

nodes.name: Enroll
nodes.notes: Run this branch once to enroll. It reads your card, plans the deposit and economics, and registers the card URL. The webhook branch above keeps serving the card afterwards.

nodes.name: Read my card
nodes.notes: The same card the webhook serves, so the plan and the published card can never disagree.

nodes.name: Plan it first
nodes.notes: Registers nothing. Read `economics`: the deposit you must hold per job, what each ending costs you, and why you are not insurable on day one. Note step 4: never leave a standing allowance to the hook.

nodes.name: Register the card
nodes.notes: Set this to the PRODUCTION URL of the "Card request" webhook above, and activate this workflow first so the URL answers. Run again any time to refresh the card.

meta.description: Serves your agent card from your own n8n, plans the enrollment (deposit, economics), then registers the card URL. Pair with workflow 2, which takes the jobs.
